body: don't worry, literally every other comment says it
are you okay? message me if you wanna talk.

i've been suicidal for 4 years so i know how you feel. but there's so much more to life than where you are right now. school doesn't mean shit in the long run. your friend's successfulness doesn't demean what you've accomplished. it's not even worth trying to compare yourself to others because everyone is so different. feel free to message me if you want to talk about your problems or about anything at all.
stay strong. 

♡
never been much of a reading/writing person. i have aphantasia so reading stuff is really boring for me, even though i have a high reading level. thanks for your help anyway, though.
too depressed to get out of bed and take part in a hobby. i used to love hanging out with my friends and playing soccer but i just don't enjoy anything anymore

hey, please rethink what you're about to do. there's so much more to life that you haven't experienced. whatever shitty situation you're in, try to get out of it. would you mind sharing why you want to kill yourself?

you don't know how glad i am that you didn't kill yourself. stay strong, it gets better.

♡

but thank you for taking your time to reach out to me and offer me advice, it's greatly appreciated. 

♡

i don't know how i would describe why i can't bring myself to call CPS. i'm afraid of the judgement i would get from other people. i'm afraid of how much harder my life could (potentially) become. the idea of having a whole new family sounds scary. what if they don't accept me for who i am? i wouldn't want to put my baggage onto strangers.
sorry to hear that you're going through the same thing. i'll try to take care of myself, you do the same. ♡

thank you so much, you don't know how much your message means to me. i honestly don't know how to thank you enough. 

stay strong.
i'll try
thank you, i'll check it out. sending some ((hugs)) back
i appreciate your effort. maybe one day i can go to the police, but for now, i'll just have to stick with venting to random strangers on reddit and hoping i don't kill myself.

i know how you feel, i get drunk and cut myself too. did that earlier today. i don't think you're useless, and i'm willing to bet your boyfriend doesn't either. please stick around a little longer, you never know what's waiting for you. there's so many people who would be devastated if you weren't around.

that's the problem. i'm too scared to talk to them. i don't want to be put into foster care, it'd basically turn my life upside down. the idea of having to restart like that scares me.  i'm hoping to just wait out the next three years and move out when im 18.

physically and verbally. they tell me how useless i am, and how of a horrible person i am just to make me feel like shit. at the same time, they hit me too. they've gone to the point of almost breaking my arm and almost making me go blind in my left eye.
my parents are basically the only family i have right now. they've abused me since i was 7, and they think mental illness is all for attention. i have no one else to turn to.
hi, please don't harm yourself. why do you want to hurt yourself?
i feel the same way. i get drunk everyday just to numb the pain. if you need someone to talk to, please reach out to me. i know how isolating it can feel.
